Author: Rajiv Gupta
Bench: Rajiv Gupta
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 22766 of 2024
Petitioner :- Hoshiyar And 2 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
1.

Sri Shiv Baboo, Advocate has filed his vakalatanama today in Court on behalf of respondent no.4,
which is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned AGA for the State-respondents, Sri Shiv Baboo,
learned counsel for the respondent no.4 and perused the record.

sentences.text: 3. The instant writ petition has been filed by the petitioners with the prayer to quash the FIR dated 27.11.2024 in Case Crime No.0621 of 2024, under Section 420, 406, 467, 468, 471, 506 IPC, Police Station- Sihani Gate, District Ghaziabad.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that from the allegations made in the first information report, prima facie no offence, complained of, is disclosed against the petitioners and as such, the impugned first information report is liable to be quashed.

5. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the respondent no.4 has submitted that on the basis of forged and fake settlement agreement, the petitioners tried to deceive the respondents.

It has further submitted that from the allegations made in the first information report, prima facie offence is clearly disclosed against the petitioners, therefore, the impugned first information report can not be quashed in view of law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of State of Telangana Vs. Habib Abdullah Jellani reported in (2017) 2 SCC 779, Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt.
Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra and Others reported in (2021) SCC Online SC 315 and in a recent decision of the Hon'ble Apex Court in Criminal Appeal No. 843 of 2024, Directorate Enforcement Vs. Niraj Tyagi and others.

entities.text: State of Telangana Vs. Habib Abdullah Jellani reported in (2017) 2 SCC 779
entities.label: PRECEDENT

Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt.
Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra and Others reported in (2021) SCC Online SC 315
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Directorate Enforcement Vs. Niraj Tyagi and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Having considered the rival submission made by learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the allegations made in the FIR and the relevant law cited by learned AGA and the fact that impugned first information report discloses cognizable offence against the petitioners, we are of the opinion that the impugned first information report can not be quashed.
7. The prayer for quashing the impugned first information report is therefore refused.

8. However in case, the petitioners move an application for anticipatory bail/ regular bail before the appropriate court, their bail applications shall be considered and disposed of as expeditiously as possible in accordance with law.
9. With the aforesaid observations, the instant writ petition is disposed of.
